summary: The recovered Table S6 contains 1,865 selected gene results across 34 neuronal subtypes. HypoExplorer pools all hypothalamic cells by mouse, and none of the author rows estimates that pooled fasting effect. The proposal changes the review to `partial / not_comparable` and leaves whole-track concordance unassessed. [Publisher’s Table S6](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124717303212-mmc7.xlsx)
openIssues: The authors’ historical data viewer was unreachable. A gene-level author table for the pooled whole-hypothalamus contrast would allow the review to reopen.
